correctness.rationale: Four exact arithmetic recurrences for auxiliary prefix deficits, a residue-sensitive strong induction proving Q(n)<=1, and a full classification of P(n)=1 exclude Abelian-cube prefixes of the auxiliary word. originality.rationale: Full accessible primary texts and the nearest published published-finding corpus result were compared by hypotheses and implications; no covering statement found. The new result is a local prescribed-start obstruction, unlike global power existence, global abelian complexity, or prefix-normal defect. Residual unindexed-priority risk remains.
residual_risks: A historically earlier unindexed note or a stronger differently named local-repetition result might cover the statement.
The 2015 Sturmian paper was inspected mainly for its all-position statement and inapplicable hypotheses; other sections do not establish paperfolding claims.
Similarity of dyadic one-third parameters does not by itself imply novelty; the published complexity and prefix-normal statements were explicitly compared by quantities.

value.rationale: Addresses the natural distinction between global abundance of Abelian powers in paperfolding (Holub) and how large a root may be necessary at a prescribed start. Explicit positions with exponentially growing forbidden root range demonstrate absence of a uniform local guarantee for all exponents >=3. This is a structural separation rather than a small enumerative increment.
